title: Suwannee Hulaween festival website
lede: A Florida festival site whose hero wordmark uses melting, swollen letters with a cyan echo outline over a dark, glittering photo.
summary: Swollen white letters with a cyan outline on a dark bokeh photo, and a dense psychedelic lineup poster below.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline: the wordmark is close to Wes Wilson’s lettering, and the lineup poster is dense and patterned, but the page ground is a dark photograph and the interface is plain.

observed: The hero is a dark photograph of out-of-focus magenta and cyan points of light.
HULAWEEN is centered in very large white letters that swell and taper, with blobby terminals and a cyan echo outline.
The dates above and LIVE OAK FL and SPIRIT OF THE SUWANNEE MUSIC PARK below are in a white serif with soft, flared shapes.
Three outlined buttons in green sit below, in a wide sans.
A light-blue panel below holds a lineup poster: dense jungle plants, flowers, and figures in green, pink, and blue around the same lettering, with band names in condensed capitals.
The navigation bar is black with spaced green capitals.
interpretation: The page keeps the style in its display lettering and in the poster image, and uses a conventional dark festival interface for everything else.
Measured values: `color.chromaticShare` 0.34 fails because the photo ground is dark; `color.hues` 5 and `type.centerShare` 0.93 pass; `color.patternShare` is 0.
borrow: Give swollen white display letters a single cyan outline to lift them from a dark ground.
Pair a psychedelic wordmark with a soft, flared serif for secondary lines.

images.alt: Hulaween home page: a dark sparkling photo with the word HULAWEEN in large swollen white letters with a cyan outline, the dates and location in white, three green outlined buttons, and below it part of a colorful lineup poster.
images.caption: First viewport of [hulaween.com](https://hulaween.com/).
